---
title: "Lab: Data visualization II: numeric & categorical data"
---

**Data:** NHANES; published public health charts (critique examples)

## Learning goals
- Choose an appropriate plot for one or two variables
- Build an age-sex pyramid
- Improve a plot's readability (scales, themes, labels)
- Recognize misleading axes and cherry-picked comparisons
